verdicts.reason: A has a jumbled reading order: the venue/time copy sits far left, away from the date, and 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' is shrunk to an unreadable size and stranded next to the can. The RSVP CTA is demoted to a pill the same size as the tag pills, so it is buried, and the placeholder logo is clipped and jammed against TASTINGS. B reads left to right and keeps a proper RSVP button on the right with the URL under it. Its flaws are a headline that is too small, so it barely beats the date line; tiny pill text; the logo crowding the decorative circle; the date and time floating apart from the pills; and the placeholder logo squeezed into the bottom-right corner.
